title: JOKERSTAN
description: all piggies become like Yaroslav Piglin the Wise
body:
**The set of resources includes piglin, brutal piglin, zombie piglin, hoglin, pigs, adding Yaroslav Piglin's clothes to them.**![piglin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6cbb769ffdeb9b62f14de48b59d082eea03d4b0a.jpeg)
**VERSION 1.2**
**- the creeper has been changed**
**- Updated cold and warm pig**
**- added a panorama**
**- updated the texture of a regular pig**
**- The immortality totem has been updated**
**- updated the summoning eggs of such mobs as: pig, creeper, hoglin, piglin, brutal piglin, **zoglin, zombie piglin**![VERSION 1.2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/90f33d453a9eec8b955f9f6a2679d450b01b46d4.png)
